customRules.title: Vite public secret-like variable
customRules.detail: Vite exposes VITE-prefixed variables to browser code.
customRules.suggestedCheck: Keep provider keys and tokens behind a server boundary.

customRules.title: Sensitive value stored in browser storage
customRules.detail: Tokens in browser storage are exposed to injected scripts.
customRules.suggestedCheck: Prefer httpOnly cookies or a short-lived server-backed session.

customRules.title: Unsafe HTML rendering
customRules.detail: Direct HTML rendering needs sanitization and an XSS regression check.
customRules.suggestedCheck: Use safe rendering or sanitize trusted HTML at the boundary.
